'''Quartz''' is a [[Minerals|Mineral]] that can be found by foraging in [[The Mines]] or [[Quarry Mine]] and in [[Skull Cavern]]. It can also occasionally be found in [[Garbage Can]]s.  [[Stone Golem]]s have a 10% chance to drop Quartz when slain.  A [[Ghostfish]] [[Fish Pond]] may produce 1 Quartz when the population reaches 3, and 3 Quartz when the population reaches 9.

Quartz can be destroyed by [[Crafting#Bombs|bombs]]. 

Quartz can be used along with 1 [[coal]] in a [[furnace]] to produce [[Refined Quartz]], taking 1.5 in-game hours to smelt.

==Bundles==
Quartz is used in the {{Bundle|geologist||y}}.

==Recipes==
Quartz is not used in any recipes.

==Smelting==
To smelt Quartz, equip it and activate the [[furnace]] while there is [[Coal]] in inventory. One unit of Coal is required for each smelting operation, regardless of the material or duration.

==Trading==
Five Quartz can be traded at the [[Desert Trader]] in [[The Desert|the Calico Desert]] for one [[Bomb]].

==Tailoring==
Quartz is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Gray Vest]].  [[File:Shirt167.png|24px]]  

==Quests==
*Quartz may be randomly requested during any season at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|75}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points.
*5 Quartz are requested by [[Ghostfish]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 1 to 3.
*5 Quartz may be requested by [[Crab]], [[Cockle]], [[Lobster]], [[Mussel]], [[Oyster]], or [[Shrimp]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 5 to 7.
